title: C++: Distributed Lock (Simulated)
description: Simulate a distributed lock service with acquire and release operations.

steps.title: Lock Manager
steps.description: Create a LockManager class with a vector of locks (bool). Implement bool acquire(int lockId) and void release(int lockId). Simulate 2 clients contending for the same lock.
hints: acquire: if locks[id] == false, set to true and return true; else return false.
